name: bugsmith
description: Turn a bug ticket (ClickUp / GitHub issue) or a plain description into a verified, reviewed pull request. Runs the full pipeline: triage -> branch -> diagnose -> fix -> tests -> verification (unit + backend + affected E2E against staging, attempted whenever possible) -> pre-PR check -> lint -> CodeRabbit-style review -> conventional commit -> PR. Config-driven and extensible, with an interactive default and a one-switch autonomous mode for headless / VegaTools use.
